generations.name: First generation (W242, Tesla powertrain)
generations.notes: Tesla-supplied powertrain and pack, 28 kWh usable (36 kWh gross with the range package), 10 kW AC, no DC fast charging. Renamed B250e for MY2016-2017; US only (no NRCan rating). Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_B-Class_Electric_Drive
